title: Rules table
description: All active rules: ID, match criteria (capabilities, risk_tags), decision type, hit count (24h), last triggered. Sorted by hits. Filterable by decision type. Mini sparkline per rule showing trigger frequency.
definitionOfDone: Columns: ID, match criteria (capabilities + risk_tags as badges), decision type (color-coded), hit count (24h), last triggered
Default sort by hit count descending
Mini sparkline (Recharts) per rule showing trigger frequency over 24h
Click rule navigates to visual rule builder focused on that rule

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/policy/RulesTable.tsx: Table of all active rules. Columns: ID (mono), match criteria (capabilities + risk_tags rendered as Badge components), decision type (color-coded Badge: allow=success, deny=danger, require_approval=warning, throttle=info), hit count 24h (number, bold if high), last triggered (relative time). Default sort: hit count descending. Filter dropdown: decision type (all, allow, deny, require_approval, throttle). Mini sparkline per rule: Recharts Sparkline (tiny LineChart, 60x20px) showing trigger frequency over 24h from rule stats data. Click rule row scrolls to / highlights that rule in the visual builder.
implementationPlan.note: Created RulesTable with: columns (ID mono, match criteria as capability+riskTag badges, decision type color-coded badge, hit count 24h with heat coloring, mini sparkline via Recharts LineChart 64x20, last triggered relative time). Default sort by hit count descending. Filter bar for decision type (all/allow/deny/approval/throttle). Click row calls onSelectRule callback. Skeleton loading and empty states.
